limitations: Receipt equity and native fill costs are observations, not an alternative equity/fill/PnL engine.
Last interval receipt marked equity may differ from final boundary-settled native cash/TOTAL.
Monthly returns use consecutive source-quote UTC month-end receipt equity, with seed10000; post-boundary final cash is separate.
Exposure is recorded native quantity times same-source recorded native close mark over saved equity; receipt sample statistics are not tick statistics.
Signed funding remains native-report UNKNOWN where no cash-delta audit exists.
saved_validation.endpoint_postprocessing: Computed solely from already retained month maxima and final native cash TOTAL; no further receipt pass.
